title: The transcription factor NF-YA10 determines the area explored by Arabidopsis thaliana roots and directly regulates LAZY genes.
authors: Barrios, Andana; Gaggion, Nicolas; Mansilla, Natanael; Blein, Thomas; Sorin, Celine; Lucero, Leandro; Ferrante, Enzo; Crespi, Martin; Ariel, Federico
journal: The Plant journal : for cell and molecular biology
one_liner_zh: 该文研究转录因子NF-YA10调控拟南芥侧根向地性与根系构型，虽涉及TF-DNA直接调控LAZY基因启动子，但核心为植物表型与基因调控，无AI/物理模拟方法，仅用深度学习表型系统，缺乏三维互作建模与结合机制研究。
abstract: Root developmental plasticity relies on transcriptional reprogramming, which largely depends on the activity of transcription factors (TFs). NF-YA2 and NF-YA10 (nuclear factor A2 and A10) are downregulated by the specific miRNA isoform miR169defg. Here, we analyzed the role of the Arabidopsis thaliana TF NF-YA10 in the regulation of lateral root (LR) development. Plants expressing a version of NF-YA10 resistant to miR169 cleavage showed a perturbation in the LR gravitropic response. By extracting several features of root architecture using an improved version of the ChronoRoot deep-learning-based phenotyping system, we uncovered that these plants showed a differential angle of LRs over time when compared to Col-0. Detailed phenotyping of root growth dynamics revealed that NF-YA10 misregulation modulates the area explored by Arabidopsis roots. Furthermore, we found that NF-YA10 directly regulates LAZY genes, which were previously linked to gravitropism, by targeting their promoter regions. Hence, the TF NF-YA10 is a new element in the control of LR bending and root system architecture.
abstract_zh: 根系发育的可塑性依赖于转录重编程，这在很大程度上取决于转录因子（TFs）的活性。NF-YA2和NF-YA10（核因子A2和A10）被特定的miRNA亚型miR169defg下调。在此，我们分析了拟南芥（Arabidopsis thaliana）转录因子NF-YA10在侧根（LR）发育调控中的作用。表达对miR169切割具有抗性的NF-YA10版本的植物，表现出侧根向地性反应的扰动。通过使用改进版的基于深度学习的ChronoRoot表型分析系统提取根系架构的多个特征，我们发现与Col-0相比，这些植物的侧根角度随时间呈现差异。根系生长动态的详细表型分析揭示，NF-YA10的失调调节了拟南芥根系所探索的区域。此外，我们发现NF-YA10通过靶向其启动子区域直接调控LAZY基因，这些基因先前与向地性相关。因此，转录因子NF-YA10是控制侧根弯曲和根系架构的一个新元件。
